title: Structifact dataset definition (authoring format)
description: Validates a hand-authored Structifact dataset YAML file (the input to `structifact validate`/`structifact generate`) against structifact/adapters/yaml.py's parsing contract and the subset of structifact/validation.py's rules that are checkable from metadata shape alone. It does NOT cover Structifact's cross-reference rules (a join's `source` naming a real entry in `sources`, a field's `source` doing the same, a foreign_key's target_table/target_column, self/duplicate depends_on across a whole collection, dataset-level duplicate-name/primary-key-count checks) — those require Structifact's own validator. Keep this file in sync with structifact/ir.py, structifact/adapters/yaml.py, and structifact/validation.py's SUPPORTED_* constants and structural checks when any of them change; it does not read those files at authoring time.

dataset.description: Preferred top-level form. Use `table` (a bare string) instead for the legacy form, never both.

table.description: Legacy top-level dataset name. Prefer `dataset: {name, description}` instead — this form carries no description.

source_table.description: The table the primary-source SELECT reads from. Omit to fall back to the dataset name.

source_filter.description: Raw SQL predicate filtering the primary source. Not parsed or validated.

depends_on.description: Names of other Structifact datasets this one depends on.

type.description: Raw type string (e.g. varchar(255), decimal(10,2), timestamp). Not restricted to a fixed list here — the alias table it's checked against lives in structifact/types.py and has changed before; encoding it here risks silently going stale. Run `structifact validate` to confirm the type is actually supported.

expression.description: Raw SQL, inlined as-is. Requires computed: true.

depends_on.description: Other field names (in this same dataset) this computed field's expression depends on. Requires computed: true.

pattern.description: Regex, checked with fullmatch semantics against real data. Only meaningful on string fields.

source.description: Must name a `sources[].name` declared in this same dataset — not checked here, see structifact validate.

dedupRule.description: Priority-based row selection within a joined-in source. Mutually exclusive with `aggregate` on the same source.

aggregateRule.description: Collapses a joined-in source to one row per group via aggregation. Mutually exclusive with `dedup` on the same source.

aggregates.description: Maps an output column alias to a raw SQL aggregate expression.

source.description: A named, joinable source. `name` is the logical alias joins/fields refer to; `table` is the physical table.

filter.description: Raw SQL predicate scoping this source instance. Not parsed or validated.

source.description: Must name a `sources[].name` declared in this same dataset — not checked here, see structifact validate.

on.description: Raw SQL join condition. IMPORTANT: this key must be quoted ("on":) in YAML — an unquoted bare `on:` is parsed by YAML 1.1 as the boolean true, not the string "on", and this schema will then correctly flag the join as missing its required `on` property.

pick_one_order_by.description: Raw SQL ordering expressions, first = highest priority. See docs/PICK_ONE_ORDER_BY_CONTRACT.md.

target_table.description: foreign_key only. Free text, not resolved against another dataset.

expression.description: check only. Raw SQL, assumed valid, never parsed.
